      @Nonnull public CompletionPostResponse execute() throws OrchestrationClientException
      Execute the request and return the low-level response.
      Returns:
      the response data object from orchestration.

    • executeStream

      @Nonnull public Stream<String> executeStream() throws OrchestrationClientException
      Execute the request with text streaming.

      The caller must close the returned stream.

      Returns:
      a stream of message text deltas.
      Throws:
      OrchestrationClientException - if the request fails or the output is filtered.

    • executeStreamDeltas

      @Nonnull public Stream<OrchestrationChatCompletionDelta> executeStreamDeltas() throws OrchestrationClientException
      Execute the request with detailed streaming deltas.

      Streaming is enabled on a copy of the supplied request. The caller must close the returned stream. Content-filter finish reasons are available in the deltas rather than converted to exceptions.

      Returns:
      a stream of chat completion deltas.
      Throws:
      OrchestrationClientException - if the request fails.
